Extract the exact comma-separated titles from the note and send Laura the requested recommendations.

```python
recommendations = [
    title.strip() for title in movie_note['content'].splitlines()
    if 'Quentin Tarantino' in title and title.strip()
]
reply = ', '.join(recommendations)
send_result = apis.phone.send_text_message(
    phone_number=laura_phone_number,
    message=reply,
    access_token=phone_access_token
)
print({'reply': reply, 'send_result': send_result})
```
